spec.title: By Total Runtime
spec.description: As per  "sproc_stats" measurement. Needs track_functions parameter set to 'pl' on monitored DBs.

spec.query: SELECT top("spread", "function_full_name", "oid", $top) FROM (SELECT spread("total_time") FROM "sproc_stats" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dbname" = '$dbname' GROUP BY time(3650d), "function_full_name", "oid" fill(none) ) WHERE spread > 0
spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  max((data->>'total_time')::float8) - min((data->>'total_time')::float8) as top,
  max((data->>'sp_calls')::int8) - min((data->>'sp_calls')::int8) as calls,
  tag_data->>'function_full_name' as function_full_name,
  tag_data->>'oid' as oid
FROM
  sproc_stats
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
GROUP BY 3, 4
ORDER BY 1 DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT $top

spec.title: By Avg. Runtime
spec.description: As per  "sproc_stats" measurement. Needs track_functions parameter set to 'pl' on monitored DBs.

spec.query: select top(avg, "function_full_name", "oid", $top) AS top from (select mean(t) / mean(c) AS avg from (SELECT spread("total_time") AS t, spread("sp_calls") AS c FROM "sproc_stats" WHERE $timeFilter AND dbname = '$dbname' GROUP BY time(3650d), "function_full_name", "oid" fill(none) )  where $timeFilter AND c > 0 group by time(3650d),  "function_full_name", "oid" )
spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  total_time / calls as top,
  calls,
  function_full_name,
  oid
FROM (
  SELECT
    tag_data->>'function_full_name' as function_full_name,
    tag_data->>'oid' as oid,
    max((data->>'total_time')::float8) - min((data->>'total_time')::float8) as total_time,
    max((data->>'sp_calls')::int8) - min((data->>'sp_calls')::int8) as calls
  FROM
    sproc_stats
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(time)
    AND dbname = '$dbname'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
) x
WHERE calls > 0
ORDER BY 1 DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT $top
